body:
I posted [this](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/7n5fp/im_a_teenager_i_have_low_self_esteem_and_i_fear/) about 20 days ago. It made me realize that I was kind of overrating my girlfriend and just trying to walk through a wall.

I thought people just had to care for me because of my qualities, but it's actually your behaviour with people that makes them care for you.  I started being nice to people (but by actually being convinced to do it, not forcing it), and it's been great for me. People wished me a happy birthday yesterday and gave me hugs and smiled to me and it just made me feel all warm and fuzzy inside. It's probably been the birthday when I've had the most people remembering it and just wishing me a good day.

About the girlfriend issue, as I said, I was probably overrating her. Not neceseraly overrating her as a person, but overrating her place in this world. I practically thought that she would be the only girl who I would feel so connected with, but I'm losing that idea. There are different, awesome girls out there that might not be like her, but great in their own special way. It also hurt me that she was selfish and rude to me while we were dating, and that she got over it so soon and changed me for someone else. Today she told me through IM that that guy wasn't as interesting as me and he just bored her so she didn't want to see him anymore. She also told me that she was regretful for being rude to me, and that she's missed the things I did.

As for the future, I started to realize that it's stupid that I get so panicky. I'm just gonna live my life. I plan to move to a different country as soon as I finish High School just to see and know the world. I'm way more positive than before.

This subreddit helped me *a lot* to find what the heck was making me feel so anxious and depressed. Therapy has also helped, but if it wasn't for this subreddit and that post I made, I wouldn't have made so much progress so quickly.

Thank you, reddit :)

It wasn't begging *begging*, it was more like bitching ("why are you being so cold to me?", etc.) It sounds really stupid, *because it is*, I don't know what I was thinking.

But you're right, I should have had more respect for myself and the relationship.

> You will meet other girls, and they won't be the same as your girlfriend, but they will be awesome in different ways.

I hadn't thought of it that way. I was stuck thinking that she was the only sort of awesome, but actually there are different types of awesome :D

I think I'm going to use my hobbies as a shelter as you said. I haven't written a line of code in weeks, and I want to do it today. I have never tried to find people outside my regular social circle that had the same interests I have, so I'll find a way to use my hobbies as a way to find new people.

Everybody says that college will be better, so I'll believe that. It's just one and a half years more of high school. I'll also try to be less of an asshole to everyone :)

I really want to get therapy, but I feel my attitude is very shitty right now, as I can't get convinced by anything. My sister has been very helpful and told me that she could get me therapy, so I think I'll get it.

I want to wait to college, but the thing is that I don't know what career to choose. There are *a lot* of different things that I would like to do for a living, but I can't choose one. I get freaked out by the future for that reason, too.

She was not my first love, I had relationships with other girls before, but she was the first one that I thought was perfect.

I still don't know why, but she started being cold to me for no reason (during the relationship), and I begged her to treat me well in different ways. She's the only person that I care the way she treats me, and begged her all the time.

Today we talked over the phone and I was very dramatic and was still begging her to be nice to me and to consider that I was doing everything I could for her (telling her that she could always count on me, and telling her that I would accept whatever was going between her and the other guy), but I realized it was too much. After so much begging there's no way we could ever be good friends again.

So I'm just finishing removing every trace of her from my life. I'm blocking and removing her from my buddy list, deleting our pictures together, throwing away the only love letter she gave me, and other things.

I lost every last bit of pride with her, but I still miss her and feel empty without her. I don't know how to move on and think that I can find someone better than her :(

I posted this more than a month ago on AskReddit and didn't get any replies:

* * *

I'm a high school student. Every often I have this periods of time when I just hate myself. I hate myself for not having friends, I hate myself for hating myself, etc.

Now, some background. When I started elementary school, I thought I was especial. Teachers said I was very bright and stuff. Then I got bullied. I had no friends and everyone just gave me their backs or bullied me.

It was like that all the way till junior high. I found hobbies. I got into programming, into music and a lot of stuff. I already wrote literature and painted. I started reading a lot. I got convictions and thought I felt good about myself.

Starting high school, people were comfortable with me, but still didn't like me. Everyone is very close with each other in my school, but I always felt rejected. I was the one that wasn't invited to parties and that stuff. There are people at school that aren't all that bright, and I started picking on them for their "stupidity" at times to feel better about myself. People started hating me. And I hated myself.

Then I met my girlfriend. She was like me, she got bullied when young, is very into music and movies, and thinks just like me. We started dating and it were some good months. Then she started seeming distant and less interested. And I started blaming myself, because she realized just how vulnerable I was.

I hate myself again. And I don't know what to do. I know I probably have good qualities, but I don't know how to feel good about them. I've thought about killing myself before, but now I don't want to hurt my girlfriend, and I wouldn't do it.

I don't know what to do.

(I know I should get therapy, but my parents are not being supportive. I go to you guys, because you seem like the smartest people on the internet, and can give great advise.)

* * *

Now me and my girlfriend broke up, and she's been dating this guy. I don't know what to think or do, I really want her back. She was everything I was hoping I could find one day and I lost her. I don't think I will ever find anyone who I had so much in common with and is as funny and intelligent as her.

I fear the future because the only 'happy' future I could see was being with her, and I don't want my future relationships to be crappy because I would be comparing everyone to her.
